quiz.q: According to Deendayal Upadhyaya's Integral Humanism, how should India approach modernization?
options: India must completely reject Western scientific methods and preserve traditional agrarian lifestyles.
India should adopt Western science to modernize while retaining indigenous cultural and moral values.
India ought to emulate Western consumer lifestyles while discarding traditional spiritual and family values.
India must adopt Nehruvian state socialism to replace indigenous traditions with Western secularism.
quiz.why: Upadhyaya argued that India should adopt Western science without adopting Western lifestyles, drawing inspiration from Japan's modernization while preserving indigenous values.

quiz.q: Why does Milan Vaishnav characterize the BJP's 2014 electoral victory as a watershed in Indian voter behavior?
options: Voters completely abandoned strategic coalition alliances in favor of single-party regional dominance.
Electoral outcomes were determined strictly by religious polarization rather than any economic issues.
Voters moved beyond pure caste identity to prioritize good economics and effective governance.
Rural voters overwhelmingly shifted allegiance from regional parties back to the traditional Congress party.
quiz.why: Vaishnav highlighted that the 2014 election represented a watershed where citizens prioritized governance and economic performance over caste identity alone.

quiz.q: According to Praful Bidwai, what major intellectual shortcoming has contributed to the decline of Indian Left parties?
options: They rely heavily on imported Western doctrines instead of developing an authentic analysis of Indian society.
They completely rejected parliamentary elections in favor of violent revolutionary takeovers across all states.
They abandoned their traditional working-class base to champion market-driven globalization and privatization policies.
They formed permanent structural alliances with right-wing cultural nationalist organizations across the country.
quiz.why: Bidwai argued that the Left failed to produce a genuine analysis of Indian society, remaining overly dependent on imported Western doctrines.

quiz.q: Which internal organizational rule did the Aam Aadmi Party adopt to prevent high-command and dynasty politics?
options: Requiring all legislative candidates to be nominated exclusively by university student unions.
Allowing party leaders to inherit executive positions after serving one legislative term.
Mandating strict democratic centralism where regional units cannot debate national party decisions.
Prohibiting two members of the same family from contesting elections or joining the executive council.
quiz.why: AAP established anti-dynastic rules barring two members of the same family from contesting elections or joining its executive council.
